title: Wuthering Heights
author: Emily Brontë
premise: On the Yorkshire moors the Earnshaw family takes in a foundling boy, Heathcliff, who forms a fierce bond with the daughter of the house, Catherine.

moments.title: Heathcliff arrives
moments.happened: Mr. Earnshaw brings home a ragged orphan from Liverpool and names him Heathcliff.
alternatives: Mr. Earnshaw leaves him in Liverpool
Heathcliff is raised at Thrushcross Grange

moments.title: Five weeks at the Grange
moments.happened: Bitten by a dog, Catherine stays with the Lintons and comes home a fine lady.
alternatives: Heathcliff stays at the Grange with her
Catherine never goes near the Grange
Catherine runs back to the Heights

moments.title: “I am Heathcliff”
moments.happened: Catherine tells Nelly she will marry Edgar. Heathcliff overhears only part of it, and vanishes.

moments.title: Heathcliff returns
moments.happened: Three years later he returns, wealthy and bent on revenge.

moments.title: Isabella elopes
moments.happened: Heathcliff elopes with Edgar’s sister Isabella to wound the Lintons.

moments.title: Catherine’s last night
moments.happened: After a last stormy meeting with Heathcliff, Catherine dies giving birth to a daughter.

moments.title: Young Cathy is trapped
moments.happened: Heathcliff traps Catherine’s daughter at the Heights and forces her to marry his son, Linton.

moments.title: The open window
moments.happened: Haunted by Catherine, Heathcliff stops eating and is found by the open window.
